# Get-ZbxAuthentication

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the server's authentication settings.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxAuthentication [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxAuthentication cmdlet reads the server's authentication settings with authentication.get: the default authentication method, the password rules, LDAP, SAML and HTTP authentication, just-in-time provisioning and multi-factor authentication. It writes one ZabbixAuthenticationSettings object and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer as a Super admin. Set-ZbxAuthentication changes the settings.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Read the password rules

```powershell
Get-ZbxAuthentication | Select-Object AuthenticationType, PasswordMinLength, PasswordCheckRules
```

PasswordCheckRules is a set of flags: the character classes a password must contain.

### Example 2: Check whether multi-factor authentication is on

```powershell
(Get-ZbxAuthentication).MfaStatus
```

MfaStatus is true when users must give a second factor; MfaId is the default method.

### -Connection

The server to talk to: a connection name from Get-ZbxContext, or the connection object. The current server when omitted.
